name: bq_agent_conversations_extended
description: On-demand multi-turn scenarios (higher cost; run manually via the adk eval CLI with tests/evals/multiturn/test_config.json): progressive disclosure and honest handling of data limits.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Hi, can you show me a trend of a baby name over time?
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: You want a MONTHLY trend of the name 'Mary' in California for the year 1950, from the bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013 table. Reveal details only when the agent asks for them, in this order: (1) the name Mary, (2) the state California, (3) the year 1950 and the exact table. If the agent explains that the table has yearly (not monthly) granularity and offers a yearly trend instead, accept that — do not insist on monthly. Once the agent delivers a trend for Mary in California built from real queried data (yearly, or monthly-if-it-finds-monthly-data), thank it and immediately end the conversation — do not accept offers for further analysis or extra queries.
